section.sectionSummaryBrief: The three matters of filling lack and wealth correspond to the three levels of revelation: Memale, Sovev, and Atzmus.
section.t: And the three above-mentioned matters—the two matters of filling the lack
(“his deficiency” and “that which he lacks”)
and wealth—correspond, in the revelations above, to the three aforementioned levels.
The two matters of filling the lack are the two revelations of Memale and Sovev.
For since the light of Sovev also relates to the worlds,
therefore,
when this light is not revealed in the world,
the world is lacking.
And as the Sages said,
on the verse,
“And Elokim completed on the seventh day”—what was the world lacking? Rest. Shabbat came, rest came.
Rest is the aspect of Sovev, which is above the light that is enclothed in the world,
and nevertheless, when this revelation was not in the world,
the world was lacking,
and when Shabbat came and this light was drawn down and revealed,
the lack was filled.
Therefore, the revelation of Sovev is also a filling of the lack.
However, the filling of the lack through the revelation of Memale is in the manner of “his deficiency,”
and the filling of the lack through the revelation of Sovev is in the manner of “that which he lacks,” even a horse to ride upon and a servant to run before him.
And wealth is the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above any relation to the worlds.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The distinction between “his deficiency” and “that which he lacks” is not only in the magnitude of the flow but also in that the latter is specifically for one accustomed to it, paralleling the levels of love—with all your heart, soul, and might—which correspond to Memale, Sovev, and Atzmus.
section.t: Now, the distinction between “his deficiency” and “that which he lacks”
(regarding a poor person in its simple sense)
is not only that the flow of “that which he lacks” is a greater flow
(even a horse to ride upon and a servant to run before him),
but also that the matter of “that which he lacks” is specifically for one who is accustomed to it.
And according to the known principle that all matters in Torah are with utmost precision,
it must be said
that the analogy of the two revelations of Memale and Sovev to the two matters of “his deficiency” and “that which he lacks” is not only because the revelation of Sovev is a more elevated revelation,
but also because the matter of filling the lack through the revelation of Sovev is specifically for one who is accustomed to it.
And the explanation of this can be understood based on what is stated in the maamar,
that the three levels of love—with all your heart,
with all your soul, and with all your might—correspond to the three aforementioned levels.
The love of “with all your heart” is in the aspect of Memale Kol Almin.
For by contemplating that the life-force of every thing is Elokus,
one will come to love Hashem with all your heart,
with both your inclinations.
Since the life-force of the aspect of Memale Kol Almin is enclothed within the creations in their innerness,
therefore,
through contemplation, this life-force is felt even in the animal soul.
And the love of “with all your soul” is in the aspect of Sovev Kol Almin.
For by contemplating that the Elokut life-force that is enclothed in the worlds is merely an illumination that is incomparable relative to the Essence of Ein Sof
(Sovev),
the wonder of Ein Sof is felt within him,
and through this he will come to the love of “with all your soul,”
that his love for Hashem is in a manner of self-sacrifice
(even if He takes your soul),
desiring to depart from his own existence and become absorbed in Ein Sof.
And this love is only in the Elokis soul.
And there are two reasons for this.
For the comprehension
[in a manner of recognition and feeling,
for only then does comprehension bring to love]
of the wonder of Ein Sof can only be in the Elokis soul,
whose root is in the Name Havayah,
Sovev.
In contrast, the creations,
since their root is from the Name Elokim,
Memale,
it is impossible for there to be in them
[even in angels, and certainly not in the animal soul]
the comprehension
(in a manner of recognition and feeling)
of Havayah,
Sovev.
And also,
because the matter of the animal soul is existence,
and the love of “with all your soul” is the desire to depart from one’s existence and become absorbed in Ein Sof,
the opposite of the matter of existence.
For the love of “with all your heart,”
which comes through contemplation and recognition that the life-force of every thing is Elokus,
relates to the existence of the loving person.
[For just as a person loves himself,
meaning he loves the life-force and desires the spreading of the life-force within him,
so too,
when he understands and feels that the main thing is the Elokut life-force,
he desires Elokus.]
Therefore,
this love also relates to the animal soul.
In contrast, the love of “with all your soul,”
which is the desire to depart from one’s existence and become absorbed in Ein Sof,
is only in the Elokis soul.
For since its root is in the Name Havayah
(Sovev),
and even after it descended below, it is a part of the Name Havayah, as it is said,
“For the portion of Havayah is His people,”
therefore it has the desire to depart from its existence and become absorbed in its root,
Sovev.
And according to the known principle
that the descent of the soul below is a descent for the purpose of an ascent,
meaning that through its descent below it will be elevated to a level more elevated than it was before its descent,
it is understood
that the intention in the descent of the soul below is that it be elevated above its root,
and that is the love of “with all your might,”
the self-sacrifice and nullification in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even Sovev.
And based on this, it can be said
that this—that the filling of the lack through the revelation of Sovev is in the manner of “that which he lacks”—
is for one who was accustomed to it,
that is,
because the souls were accustomed
(before their descent below)
to the revelation of Sovev.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Although the revelation of Sovev fills a lack specifically for souls accustomed to it, it also fills a lack for the world because the soul’s descent is to elevate the world, making it relate to Sovev.
section.t: And it must be understood,
that according to the above explanation,
this—that the revelation of Sovev is included in the filling of the lack—is specifically regarding souls,
in contrast to regarding creations, where it would seemingly not apply to say that the revelation of Sovev is a filling of the lack,
since they are not accustomed to it.
And from the fact that the maamar brings what the Sages said, “What was the world lacking? Rest,” etc.,
it is understood that when there is no revelation of Sovev
(rest),
it is a lack also in the world.
And it can be said,
that since the primary intention in the descent of the soul below is
(not for the sake of the soul’s ascent,
but rather)
in order to rectify
[and elevate]
the world,
therefore,
through the love of “with all your soul” of the souls that descended below into the world,
the world is elevated to a level more elevated than it is in itself,
so that it becomes related to the level of Sovev
(in the manner of the relation of souls to Sovev),
to the extent that
when the revelation of Sovev does not shine,
the world is lacking.
